characters.name: Anna
characters.clueEn: She was beside a water square.

characters.name: Breta
characters.clueEn: She was beside a tree in Hole 4. She had a higher hole number than Harry,
characters.clueZh:
在 4 号球洞的树旁边。
球洞号比 Harry 高。

characters.name: Carson
characters.clueEn: He was not in the first or in the last column.
characters.clueZh:
不在第一列
或最后一列。

characters.name: Edna
characters.clueEn: She occupied the flag in an even-numbered hole.
characters.clueZh:
占据一个偶数号
球洞的旗帜。

characters.name: Flor
characters.clueEn: She did not occupy the hole immediately before Naomi's hole.
characters.clueZh:
不在 Naomi 所在球洞的
上一个球洞。

characters.name: Gerald
characters.clueEn: He was the only man to occupy a golf tee.
characters.clueZh:
是唯一占据发球台
的男人。

characters.name: Harry
characters.clueEn: In his hole, there was a woman in a cart.
characters.clueZh:
所在球洞里
有一名在球车里的女人。

characters.name: Iris
characters.clueEn: She was northwest of Flor and in the same hole.
characters.clueZh:
在 Flor 西北边，
在同一个球洞。

characters.name: Jana
characters.clueEn: She occupied the golf tee on either the Hole 6, 7 or 8.
characters.clueZh:
占据 6、7 或 8 号球洞
的发球台。

characters.name: Kent
characters.clueEn: He was in the same hole as Mona.
characters.clueZh:
和 Mona 在同一个
球洞。

characters.name: Lars
characters.clueEn: His hole number is greater than Naomi's hole number.
characters.clueZh:
球洞号比 Naomi
的球洞号高。

characters.name: Mona
characters.clueEn: She was on the flag for either Hole 3, 4 or 5.
characters.clueZh:
在 3、4 或 5 号
球洞的旗帜上。

characters.name: Naomi
characters.clueEn: She was within a sand pit.

characters.name: Oscar
characters.clueEn: He was in the northmost row and beside a tree.
characters.clueZh:
在最北的一行，
在树旁边。

characters.name: Vinny
characters.clueEn: The Victim. He was alone with the murderer.
characters.clueZh: 被害者。和凶手单独在一起。

generalClues.text: 偶数号球洞中的人数为偶数（包括零人）。
generalClues.textEn: Even-numbered holes have an even number of occupants (this includes zero occupants).

generalClues.text: 奇数号球洞中的人数为奇数。
generalClues.textEn: Odd-numbered holes have an odd number of occupants.
